commands.author: clawsweeper[bot]
commands.review_summary:
Dependabot changes the Vite dev dependency from `^8.1.2` to `^8.1.3` in `package.json` and refreshes `pnpm-lock.yaml`.

Reproducibility: yes. The issue is source-reproducible from the PR diff: `package.json` only bumps Vite, while the lockfile also changes unrelated direct runtime dependency resolutions.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A narrow automated repair can regenerate the dependency update so the lockfile does not include unrelated direct runtime package upgrades.
